title: Associate Designer, Cook & Dine
note: Housewares design for retail private-label brands; 1–2 years of experience.

facts.summary: Early-career designer on cookware, bakeware, closet/laundry goods and luggage for Walmart private-label home brands.
facts.duties: About 60% design work (sketches, decoration artwork, CADs, spec sheets, trend boards) and 40% supplier support (design packages, sample tracking, redlines).
facts.requirements: 1–2 years of experience, Illustrator, Photoshop and PowerPoint, plus a portfolio. Rhino, SolidWorks and KeyShot are a plus.
facts.apply: Apply through Earthbound's BambooHR careers page (posted 2026-11-02).
